articles.title: Oxford Bank (OXBC) Q3 Earnings Build On Profit Growth As Credit Risk Lingers
articles.summary: Oxford Bank walked into its Q3 2026 report with a reputation as a quietly efficient lender and a valuation story built around an 11.8x P/E and a discounted cash flow estimate well above the current share price. The stock barely flinched after the release, ticking up only 0.5% to US$49. The quarter itself told a stronger story than that muted move suggested.
